questions.text: Financial Health Documentation: Submit comprehensive financial information: Audited financial statements; Auditor information; Management accounts; Cash flow statement; Customer concentration; Backlog; Debt agreements; Cap table.
questions.evidence_required: Audited financials (3 years), Management accounts, Cap table

questions.text: Entity-Specific Financial Analysis: Provide analysis based on entity type (Private, Startup, Public, SOE): Revenue quality; Burn rate; Funding stage; Segment fit; Government fiscal health.
questions.evidence_required: Financial analysis report, Credit rating report

questions.text: Financial Stability Risk Assessment: Provide financial risk analysis: Failure probability; Early warning indicators; Covenants proximity; Refinancing risk; Recommended protections.
Organizational Commitment Evidence: Demonstrate market commitment depth: Legal entity structure; Staff presence; Capital investment; Executive engagement; Strategic roadmap; Public commitments.
questions.evidence_required: Org chart, Investment records, Roadmap deck

questions.text: Product/Market Fit & Localization: Assess product adaptation for market: Feature localization; Pricing adaptation; UX localization; Regulatory readiness; Local partnerships; Customer success infrastructure.
questions.evidence_required: Product roadmap, Localization plan, Partnership agreements

questions.text: Historical Commitment Analysis: Provide market entry/exit track record: Market portfolio; Market duration; Exit analysis; Exit count; Entry strategy.
questions.evidence_required: Historical market data, Exit case studies

questions.text: Competitive Position: Assess market strength and sustainability: Market share; Competitive differentiation; Win/loss rate; Market perception; Competitive dynamics.
questions.evidence_required: Market share report, Win/loss analysis, Analyst reports

questions.text: Reference Portfolio: Provide diverse reference sample: Vendor-provided references; Contact information; Reference relevance; Relationship timeline.
questions.evidence_required: Reference list with contacts, Project summaries

questions.text: Structured Reference Interviews: References will be assessed on: Delivery quality; Technical reliability; Support responsiveness; Problem resolution; Value for money; Innovation; Communication; Relationship quality.
Reference Analysis: Provide reference validation: Quantitative scoring; Pattern analysis; Issue recurrence; Vendor vs. independent gap; Competitive intelligence.
Business Ethics Assessment: Demonstrate ethical business conduct: Pricing transparency; Sales honesty; Contract fairness; Competitive conduct; IP respect; Data privacy; Conflicts of interest.
questions.evidence_required: Code of conduct, Ethics policy, Audit reports

questions.text: Labor & Human Rights: Provide labor practices evidence: Wage practices; Working conditions; Local hiring; Labor rights; Diversity and inclusion; Working hours; Supply chain labor.
questions.evidence_required: Labor audit reports, HR policies, Supply chain audits

questions.text: Environmental & Social Responsibility: Document ESG practices: Environmental impact; Community engagement; Data privacy/security; Anti-corruption; Transparency.
questions.evidence_required: ESG report, ISO 14001 cert, Community impact report

questions.text: Controversies & Violations Background Check: Disclose all material controversies: Legal disputes; Regulatory fines; Negative media coverage; NGO reports.

scoring_notes: Layer 5 composite formula: Weighted average of sub-dimensions.
